agent.description: Lucas Green is a brand new, sought-after development of homes in the town of Solihull, which is just 30 minutes' drive away from central Birmingham. Offering a wonderful range of 2-bedroom apartments and 2, 3, and 4-bedroom homes, Lucas Green is an ideal location for a variety of potential buyers, including families, young professionals, and commuters.
agent.address:

agent.name: Bellway Homes - Lucas Green

development.transport:
Those looking to commute for work have a variety of options, as Lucas Green is well-situated when it comes to transport links. Shirley Train Station, just two-and-a-half miles away from the development, provides regular northern services into Birmingham, a 16-minute trip, and services travelling south-bound towards Stratford-upon-Avon - which is roughly 40 minutes away.

Alternatively, those with vehicles can reach Solihull in around 10 minutes and Birmingham city centre in less than 25 minutes. Plus, Coventry is just over 15 miles away from Lucas Green.

As an option for travel in the future, the planned HS2 facilities will be located only a short drive away from the development, with Birmingham Interchange only a 15-minute drive and Birmingham Curzon Street only 25 minutes away.
development.directions:
Lucas Green is located in the town of Solihull, a little under nine miles south-east of Birmingham city centre. It can be reached within just over five minutes' drive of Junction 4 of the M42, via the A34.

This development falls under the administration of Solihull Council.
development.leisure:
Lucas Green's location in Solihull means it's ideally situated for a huge range of entertainment options and leisure activities - especially with both a gym and a coffee shop on the doorstep of the development. 
The Village Health and Wellness Club is a six-minute walk away, providing a state-of-the-art gym and fitness centre, as well as a number of classes.
For lovers of the outdoors, Earlswood Lakes is little more than a five-minute drive away from Lucas Green and is perfect for walking, wildlife watching, and so much more.
Under 10 minutes' drive away from the development is Umberslade Adventure, a wonderful location for all the family where activities such as rope courses, archery, and nature trails are available.
Less than eight miles away from Lucas Green is Cadbury World, where visitors will have the opportunity to learn about the origins of the business, make their own chocolate, and go on a 4D chocolate adventure.

development.education:
Residents of Lucas Green with children will be pleased with the number of schools in the areas around the development. Our Lady of the Wayside Catholic Primary School is a little under a mile away from Lucas Green; Dickens Heath Community Primary School is less than five minutes' drive away; and Cranmore Infant School is just over a mile away.

For older students, Tudor Grange Academy is under 10 minutes' drive away from Lucas Green.

University education is also on offer in the area, with both the University of Birmingham and Birmingham City University around a 25-minute drive away from the development.
development.shopping:
There are a whole host of options for residents of Lucas Green with regards to picking up everyday essentials, as the development is located only one-and-a-half miles away from several well-known supermarkets.

Additionally, there are also a number of shopping centres in the area, including Mell Square Shopping Centre and Touchwood Solihull - which are only around a 10-minute drive away from Lucas Green.

property.description:
Plot 50 (The Astley) - priced at £257,500

What if your home was a Bellway home?

What if you had a home you could call yours? Where there’s room to grow, there’s no chain or chaos, and you can save thousands. A blank canvas that you can truly make yours. Sounds perfect, doesn’t it? If you’re ready to move, our homes are ready for you. Available on selected plots only. Terms and conditions apply.

About the Home
The Astley is a fantastic 2-bedroom apartment ideal for couples seeking a little more space.

The open-plan kitchen, living, and dining area is the hub of the home – a multi-purpose space in which to relax and host guests. The L-shaped fitted kitchen comes complete with an array of integrated appliances for a ready-to-use appeal, while the living area has the added benefit of French doors – perfect when looking to enjoy nicer weather.

Across the hall, one of the bedrooms is double in size and features an en-suite shower room, with the family bathroom ideal for the use of bedroom 2.

A useful cupboard completes the interior, an ideal storage solution to keep clutter at bay.

About the Development

Lucas Green is a brand new, sought-after development of homes in the town of Solihull, which is just 30 minutes’ drive away from central Birmingham. Offering a wonderful range of 2-bedroom apartments and 2, 3, and 4-bedroom homes, Lucas Green is an ideal location for a variety of potential buyers, including families, young professionals, and commuters.

Register your interest of our properties in Solihull today!

Why Buy With Bellway?

At Bellway we have always built attractive and desirable new homes. That's why we've become one of the five largest builders in Britain. But now there's even more reason to choose a Bellway home.

To make the whole process of selling and buying easier, we've put together a range of services to make your move as hassle free as possible.

Express Mover

Sell your home quicker with no estate agent fees.^

Our Intermediate Management Agent will work with a local estate agent to market your home at an agreed price.

You could soon be moving into your new dream home, start your journey with us today.

Low-cost mortgage
